meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会生成一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范文件,供 Google Stitch 生成界面时参照,写明配色(限一个强调色、禁纯黑与紫蓝霓虹)、字体、布局、动效和禁止清单。
howto.when: 当你想为 Google Stitch 项目定下一套设计规范、或需要一份供 Stitch 提示用的 DESIGN.md 时进入。前提是能访问 labs.google/stitch。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目写一份 DESIGN.md 设计规范
say.note: 产出供 Stitch 使用的规范文件

say.text: 检查这份 DESIGN.md 里还有哪些被禁的 AI 套路
say.note: 对照禁止清单逐条排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes a DESIGN.md design-system file for your project, meant to guide Google Stitch screen generation: color calibration, typography, layout, motion, and a banned-pattern list.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to define a design language for a Google Stitch project, or need a DESIGN.md to prompt Stitch with. Requires access to labs.google/stitch.

say_en.text: Write a DESIGN.md design spec for this project
Set the vibe to Density 4, Variance 8, Motion 6
Flag any banned AI patterns left in this DESIGN.md
say_en.note: Checks it against the ban list
